packages.name: hello-world-pipeline
packages.description: A 3-node hello-world workflow — encrypt, decrypt, and reveal messages using a Caesar cipher. The simplest multi-node pipeline for learning Salpa.
packages.author: BoundaryComputing

nodes.name: hello-encrypt
nodes.description: Encrypts a message using a Caesar cipher and writes the ciphertext to a file

nodes.name: hello-decrypt
nodes.description: Decrypts a Caesar-cipher message from a file and writes the plaintext

nodes.name: hello-reveal
nodes.description: Generates a visual report comparing encrypted and decrypted messages

packages.name: metaldock-vwf
packages.description: Visual workflow nodes for metal-protein docking: the refactored MetalDock pipeline (protein prep, ligand prep, QM/ORCA CM5 charges, ligand PDBQT with metal-aware torsion tree, AutoDock4 docking, results analysis) wired as chainable Salpa nodes. Each node wraps one src/metaldock_modules function; molecular graphs are serialized to JSON between nodes.
packages.author: BoundaryComputing / MetalDock

nodes.name: mdock-protein-prep
nodes.description: Clean a protein PDB, protonate with pdb2pqr, and convert to PDBQT (prepare_receptor4) — MetalDock pipeline step 1

nodes.name: mdock-ligand-prep
nodes.description: Canonicalize a metal-complex XYZ (OpenBabel) and build its molecular graph — MetalDock pipeline step 2

nodes.name: mdock-qm-charges
nodes.description: DFT (ORCA/Gaussian/ADF) → CM5 partial charges + Mayer bond orders → enrich molecular graph — MetalDock pipeline step 3

nodes.name: mdock-ligand-pdbqt
nodes.description: Convert a charge-enriched molecular graph into an AutoDock PDBQT with ROOT/BRANCH torsion tree (metal-aware freezing) — MetalDock pipeline step 4

nodes.name: mdock-autodock-run
nodes.description: Generate GPF/DPF, run autogrid4 + autodock4, and extract docked poses — MetalDock pipeline step 5

nodes.name: mdock-results-analysis
nodes.description: Binding energies, ligand efficiency, interacting residues, and RMSD from docking output — MetalDock pipeline step 6

packages.name: metalparm-vwf
packages.description: Visual workflow nodes for metal force-field parameterization: EasyParm pipeline (bond detection, MOL2 generation, ORCA local/HPC, Seminario, FF assembly, library generation) + metallopeptide fragment builder, peptide builder, pure-geometry fragment alignment, two-step fragment fuser (topology + coord-applier), AMBER → GROMACS converter, packmol-memgen-based mixed-solvent box builder, and a GROMACS-side solvator (md_solvate_gmx) that uses raw packmol + ParmEd so non-standard residues are never re-derived.
packages.author: BoundaryComputing / MetalParm

nodes.name: ep-bond-detection
nodes.description: Detect bonds, angles, and dihedrals from optimized XYZ geometry using covalent radii (easyPARM step 02)

nodes.name: ep-mol2-generation
nodes.description: Generate MOL2 file via antechamber with atom type correction for metals (easyPARM antechamber step)

nodes.name: ep-charges
nodes.description: Inject QM-derived (ORCA RESP / CHELPG) partial charges into the zero-charge MOL2 from antechamber — the EasyParm charge step the node refactor originally omitted.

nodes.name: xtb-opt
nodes.description: GFN-xTB geometry optimization (semi-empirical, local). Fast pre-optimizer for metal-containing fragments before the expensive ep_orca_run DFT step.

nodes.name: ep-orca-run
nodes.description: Run ORCA (QM DFT opt+freq+CHELPG) locally or on a SLURM HPC cluster. Produces .out/.hess/.xyz artifacts consumed by ep_seminario_orca.

nodes.name: ep-seminario-orca
nodes.description: Compute bond and angle force constants from ORCA Hessian using the Modified Seminario Method

nodes.name: ep-forcefield-assembly
nodes.description: Assemble AMBER force field: MOL2 correction, parmchk2, ULS labeling, merge Seminario params, UFF fill, cleanup (easyPARM steps 03-13)

nodes.name: ep-library-generation
nodes.description: Generate AMBER library (.lib) file via tleap and fix atomic numbers/bond orders (easyPARM steps tleap + 12)

nodes.name: snp-builder
nodes.description: Build a capped Sn(IV)(OMe)2-porphyrin fragment from a YASARA-style Zn-porphyrin PDB (UNK residue). Outputs XYZ + PDB ready for EasyParm parameterization. Optionally extracts the peptide chain — whole, or a residue-number sub-span (e.g. 1-7) to carve a shorter peptide out of a longer one — and can ACE/NME-cap the extracted termini.

nodes.name: peptide-builder
nodes.description: Build a standalone peptide PDB from a sequence (via tleap) or accept a user-supplied PDB. Forwards peptide.pdb + forcefield to ep_fragment_fuse_topology so the fuse node stays a pure fuser.

nodes.name: fragment-align
nodes.description: Pure-geometry rigid-body placement of a parameterized fragment onto a peptide anchor (Avogadro-style). Re-saves the fragment OFF library with aligned coordinates so ep_fragment_fuse_topology can combine peptide + fragment with chemically sensible interface geometry — no minimization needed.

nodes.name: ep-fragment-fuse-topology
nodes.description: Topology-only fuser: merge a standard ff19SB peptide library with a custom residue library (.lib + .frcmod) via user-specified interface bonds. Emits complex.prmtop only — coordinate assembly is handled by the sister ep_apply_coords node. Rebalances the non-integer net charge that interface-atom deletion leaves on the linkage residue so the complex total is an exact integer.

nodes.name: ep-apply-coords
nodes.description: Place aligned source-PDB coordinates onto a topology-only complex.prmtop and write the final complex.rst7 + complex.pdb. Sister of ep_fragment_fuse_topology — together they replace the v1.11.0 monolithic ep_fragment_fuse.

nodes.name: ep-amber-to-gromacs
nodes.description: Convert AMBER prmtop+rst7 to GROMACS top+gro via ParmEd

nodes.name: md-solvate-packmol
nodes.description: Solvate a metallopeptide AMBER topology in mixed or single solvent boxes via AmberTools' packmol-memgen. Bundled cosolvent library covers methanol, chloroform, DMSO, NMA, acetonitrile, acetone, benzene, phenol, TFE — all AMBER-compatible.

nodes.name: md-solvate-gmx
nodes.description: Solvate a metallopeptide GROMACS topology (from ep_amber_to_gromacs) with OPC water + Cieplak methanol + ions, using raw packmol + ParmEd assembly. Bypasses packmol-memgen's internal tleap re-derivation, so non-standard residues (fragment-fused GLU, etc.) are preserved bytewise.

nodes.name: md-traj-center
nodes.description: PBC-correct an MD trajectory before analysis: make the solute (metallopeptide) whole across periodic boundaries, centre it in the box, and wrap solvent/membrane back in. The MDAnalysis equivalent of 'gmx trjconv -pbc whole -center -pbc mol'; produces a clean .xtc for md_analysis_helix / md_analysis_distance.

nodes.name: md-analysis-helix
nodes.description: Per-frame α-helix content of a peptide along an MD trajectory, via DSSP (MDAnalysis). Reads .xtc/.trr + .tpr/.gro and writes a CSV time series of helix fraction + a per-residue helix propensity.

nodes.name: md-analysis-distance
nodes.description: Per-frame distance from a set of probe atoms (Tyr/His quenchers) to the metal centre (Sn) along an MD trajectory, via MDAnalysis. Minimum-image (PBC-aware); writes a CSV time series in Ångström + a closest-approach summary.

nodes.name: md-membrane-build
nodes.description: Embed a dry metallopeptide GROMACS topology in a DPPC bilayer (transmembrane) via packmol-memgen + ParmEd, and emit a solvated GROMACS topology for membrane MD. Like md_solvate_gmx, the solute topology is preserved bytewise — never re-derived by tleap — so fragment-fused residues survive.

packages.name: pdbmdauto
packages.description: Automated protein structure preparation for molecular dynamics — homology modeling, solvation, relaxation
packages.author: BoundaryComputing

nodes.name: pdb-fasta-biopython
nodes.description: Parse PDB structures and extract FASTA sequences using BioPython. Supports RCSB PDB API fetching by ID and local file processing with chain splitting, HETATM handling, and missing residues analysis.

nodes.name: gen-ali
nodes.description: Generate alignment files for homology modeling from PDB structure and FASTA sequences

nodes.name: gen-multi-chain-ali
nodes.description: Merge per-chain alignment files into a single multi-chain alignment for homology modeling

nodes.name: merge-pdb-chains
nodes.description: Merge selected PDB chains into a single structure file for homology modeling

nodes.name: fix-residues-promod3
nodes.description: Fix missing residues in PDB structures using ProMod3 homology modeling engine

nodes.name: pdb2pqr
nodes.description: Converts PDB files to PQR format with protonation states, hydrogen addition, and charge assignment using PDB2PQR. Supports PROPKA pKa predictions and multiple force fields.

nodes.name: pka-gmx-em
nodes.description: pH-dependent protonation (PDB2PQR/PROPKA) + GROMACS topology (pdb2gmx) + two-step vacuum energy minimisation

nodes.name: ori-ndx-builder
nodes.description: Build GROMACS index groups (OriHeavy, OriBackBone) for original vs homology-modeled residues

nodes.name: gen-gmx-ndx
nodes.description: Generate GROMACS index groups for original vs modeled residues

nodes.name: gmx-solv-ion
nodes.description: GROMACS solvation and ionization — add water box and neutralize with ions

nodes.name: gmx-md-relax
nodes.description: GROMACS multi-step relaxation — energy minimization and NVT equilibration

nodes.name: gmx-mdrun-local
nodes.description: Simple GROMACS MD simulation node for local execution - ideal for demos, tutorials, and testing

nodes.name: gmx-mdrun
nodes.description: GROMACS MD simulation node with local and HPC/SLURM execution support

workflows.name: Hello World Pipeline
workflows.description: A 3-node workflow that encrypts, decrypts, and reveals a secret message using a Caesar cipher. Demonstrates multi-node pipelines, data flow via case_name, and file-based communication between nodes.
workflows.author: BoundaryComputing

workflows.name: MetalDock 1JZI Re Pipeline
workflows.description: Metal-aware docking of the Re(phen)(CO)3 complex into azurin (PDB 1JZI) — the vacancy-coordination-sphere case from the MetalDock paper. Receptor preparation, ligand molecular graph, GFN1-xTB CM5 charges, metal-aware ligand PDBQT, AutoDock4 search and pose analysis. The inputs ship inside the nodes and the charge engine installs with them, so it runs as loaded with nothing to download.
workflows.author: BoundaryComputing

workflows.name: HSA + Ferrocene (Sudlow site I)
workflows.description: Site-directed docking of ferrocene into human serum albumin — a protein with no metal complex bound. Unlike the 1JZI case this is a prediction, not a redocking: the receptor is apo (PDB 1AO6, chain A), the ligand is an independent xtb-optimised geometry, and the search box is placed on Sudlow site I using the position of R-warfarin co-crystallised in 2BXD, transferred by superposition. Exercises AutoDock's internal Fe parameters.
workflows.author: BoundaryComputing

workflows.name: PDBmdAuto Full Pipeline
workflows.description: Automated 11-node MD preparation pipeline: PDB fetch, homology modeling (ProMod3), protonation, GROMACS topology, solvation, vacuum & solvated relaxation, and production MD. Demo: protein 4Z8J (SNX27 PDZ + PTHR peptide, 2 chains, 5 missing residues).
workflows.author: BoundaryComputing
